shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.desc: Loose an arrow. Accuracy drops beyond optimal range.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.desc: A bolt of raw force that ignores a quarter of Defense.

staff_strike.name: Staff Strike
staff_strike.desc: A heavy blow with a living staff.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.desc: Slam the target with your shield. May Stun.

brace.name: Brace
brace.desc: Restore half of your max Defense and gain +15 Dodge until your next turn.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Enemies within 2 tiles must attack you next turn.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.desc: You and adjacent allies count as in half cover for 2 turns.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.desc: Passive. Your zone of control reaches 2 tiles, and your attacks of opportunity deal +50% damage.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.desc: Capstone. Plant your shield: for 2 turns you and allies within 2 tiles take 40% less damage from attacks, and adjacent enemies are Taunted.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Hit the target and every enemy adjacent to both of you.

battle_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
battle_hunger.desc: Passive. +8% damage and +4 Crit; heal for 10% of the damage you deal.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: Break half of the target's current Defense before the hit lands.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.desc: Leap at an enemy up to 2 tiles away and strike it for 1.0x damage, then leap on up to two more enemies, each within 2 tiles of the last. You end next to the last one.

headlong_charge.name: Headlong Charge
headlong_charge.desc: Charge an enemy 2-4 tiles away in a straight line: 1.4x damage, knocks it back and Stuns it if it hits something.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: Capstone. Passive. Once per turn, killing an enemy gives you your action back. +10% damage.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: A precise strike. +25 Crit if the target has no cover from you.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.desc: Step through the shadows to a tile within 4. Ignores zones of control. Uses your move, not your action.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.desc: Fill a 3x3 area with smoke for 2 turns. Units inside gain +30 Dodge against ranged attacks.

unseen.name: Unseen
unseen.desc: Passive. Enemies notice you from 3 tiles closer while you explore, and you deal +30% damage to enemies that are not yet aware of the squad.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.desc: A killing blow: 2x damage and +20 Crit.

death_blossom.name: Death Blossom
death_blossom.desc: Capstone. Vanish and reappear on a tile within 5, striking every adjacent enemy for 1.4x damage with +25 Crit.

poisoned_blade.name: Poisoned Blade
poisoned_blade.desc: A tainted cut that may Poison.

throwing_knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing_knives.desc: Throw knives up to 4 tiles away. May cause Bleed.

crippling_strike.name: Crippling Strike
crippling_strike.desc: Hamstring the target: may Root it and cause Bleed.

venom_mastery.name: Venom Mastery
venom_mastery.desc: Passive. Poison and Bleed you inflict deal +50% damage and have +10 chance to land.

venom_cloud.name: Venom Cloud
venom_cloud.desc: Burst a vial over a 3x3 area: light damage and Poison.

plague.name: Plague Flask
plague.desc: Capstone. Shatter a plague flask over a 5x5 area within 5 tiles: 0.6x damage, heavy Poison and Blind.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.desc: Take careful aim: 1.3x damage and +15 Accuracy.

steady_hands.name: Steady Hands
steady_hands.desc: Passive. +15 Accuracy if you have not moved this turn.

keen_sight.name: Keen Sight
keen_sight.desc: Passive. +2 vision and +10 Crit with ranged attacks.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.desc: An arrow that passes through every unit in a line.

deaths_eye.name: Death's Eye
deaths_eye.desc: Capstone. A perfect shot: 3x damage, +25 Accuracy and +25 Crit, and cover does not help the target.

pinning_arrow.name: Pinning Arrow
pinning_arrow.desc: An arrow through the foot. May Root.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.desc: Mark a target for 3 turns: all attacks against it gain +15 hit, and it stays visible through the fog.

snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
snare_trap.desc: Hide a trap within 3 tiles. The first enemy to enter takes damage and is Rooted for 2 turns.

predator.name: Predator
predator.desc: Passive. +20% damage and +15 hit against Marked, Rooted or Pinned enemies.

kill_zone.name: Kill Zone
kill_zone.desc: Capstone. Watch a killing field: until your next turn, shoot every enemy that moves within range. Ends your turn.

mend.name: Mend
mend.desc: Heal an ally within 4 tiles. Heals a Downed ally back to their feet.

firebolt.name: Fireball
firebolt.desc: A ball of fire bursts on a 3x3 area: 0.75x damage that swings wildly (half to one and a half), may Burn. Always hits, allies in the blast too.

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.desc: A spear of ice through every unit in a line 5 tiles long: 1.2x damage that swings wildly, may Paralyze. Always hits, allies in the line too.

pyro_passion.name: Kindled
pyro_passion.desc: Passive. +20 Burn chance and +50% Burn damage.

flame_wave.name: Flame Wave
flame_wave.desc: A cone of fire 3 tiles long: 1.4x damage that swings wildly, may Burn. Always hits, allies in the cone too.

arcane_focus.name: Arcane Focus
arcane_focus.desc: Passive. Your area spells never roll below their average damage, and your attacks ignore another 15% of Defense.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: Capstone. A meteor falls on a 5x5 area: 1.3x damage that swings wildly and ignores half of Defense, Burn, and the ground catches fire. Always hits, allies under it too.

purify.name: Purify
purify.desc: Remove every harmful effect from an ally, Stabilize them and heal a little.

ward.name: Ward
ward.desc: Restore an ally's Defense to full and grant +8 Defense for 2 turns.

oracle_sight.name: Foretelling
oracle_sight.desc: Passive. Heals are 30% stronger; allies within 2 tiles gain +10 Resolve.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.desc: An ally gains +30 Dodge for 2 turns and acts sooner.

guardian_spirit.name: Guardian Spirit
guardian_spirit.desc: An ally within 4 tiles cannot drop below 1 HP for 2 turns and gains +8 Defense.

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.desc: Capstone. Every ally within 4 tiles is cleansed and healed for a large amount; the Downed rise.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.desc: Pull an enemy up to 3 tiles toward you.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.desc: Push an enemy 2 tiles. It is Stunned if it hits something.

drown.name: Drown
drown.desc: Flood a 3x3 area for 3 turns. Enemies in the water lose 20 Dodge and take damage each turn.

tidal_wave.name: Tidal Wave
tidal_wave.desc: A wave 3 tiles long: 0.8x damage and pushes enemies 2 tiles; they are Stunned if they hit something.

drowning_depths.name: Drowning Depths
drowning_depths.desc: Passive. +25% damage against enemies standing in water or a flood.

surge.name: Surge
surge.desc: The sea bursts out around you: every enemy within 2 tiles takes 0.8x damage and is pushed 2 tiles away (Stunned if it hits something), and the ground around you floods for 2 turns.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.desc: Capstone. A great wave 4 tiles long: 1.2x damage, pushes enemies 3 tiles and floods the ground for 2 turns.

barbed_harpoon.name: Barbed Harpoon
barbed_harpoon.desc: A barbed throw: 1.2x damage and may cause Bleed.

anchor_stance.name: Anchor Stance
anchor_stance.desc: Restore your Defense to full and gain +8 Defense for 2 turns.

kraken_grip.name: Kraken Grip
kraken_grip.desc: Seize an enemy up to 3 tiles away: 0.9x damage, pull it 2 tiles toward you and may cause Bleed.

gutting_harpoon.name: Gutting Harpoon
gutting_harpoon.desc: A brutal throw that tears flesh: 1.7x damage and may cause heavy Bleed.

drag_to_the_depths.name: Drag to the Depths
drag_to_the_depths.desc: Capstone. Harpoon an enemy 2-5 tiles away: 2.2x damage and heavy Bleed, then reel it in next to you and may Root it for 2 turns.

lantern_flare.name: Lantern Flare
lantern_flare.desc: A blinding flash. May Blind (-30 Accuracy).

reveal.name: Reveal
reveal.desc: Flood a 3x3 area within 5 tiles with light: enemies there are Marked for 2 turns (+15 to hit them) and hidden foes are revealed.

dazzle.name: Dazzle
dazzle.desc: A burst of glare over a 3x3 area: 0.6x damage that ignores a quarter of Defense, may Blind (-30 Accuracy) for 2 turns.

searing_flash.name: Searing Flash
searing_flash.desc: A searing flash in the target's eyes: 1.2x damage that ignores half of Defense, may Stun.

afterglow.name: Afterglow
afterglow.desc: Passive. +1 Range. Your Blind and Stun have +15 chance to land, and your Blind and Mark last 1 turn longer.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.desc: 2x damage that ignores half of Defense; 2.6x against creatures of the Hush.

dawn.name: Dawn
dawn.desc: Capstone. Become the dawn: every enemy within 4 tiles takes 1.0x damage that ignores half of Defense, is Blinded and Marked and may be Stunned; hidden foes are revealed.

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.desc: Heal an ally within 4 tiles. A Downed ally stands back up.

guiding_light.name: Guiding Light
guiding_light.desc: Allies in a 3x3 area within 4 tiles gain +15 Accuracy for 2 turns.

shepherd.name: Shepherd
shepherd.desc: Passive. Your heals are 30% stronger and allies within 2 tiles regenerate 3 HP at the start of their turns.

remembrance.name: Remembrance
remembrance.desc: An ally within 4 tiles has every cooldown reset, and skills erased by the Hush return.

hall_of_lanterns.name: Hall of Lanterns
hall_of_lanterns.desc: Hang lanterns over a 3x3 area within 4 tiles for 3 turns: allies there are cleansed, heal 6 HP at the start of their turns and are immune to Fear, and the Hush cannot erase their skills.

unforgetting.name: The Unforgetting
unforgetting.desc: Capstone. Every ally within 4 tiles has their cooldowns cut by 2 turns, heals, cannot drop below 1 HP until their next turn, and skills erased by the Hush return.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.desc: Roots burst from the ground and may Root the target for 2 turns.

deep_roots.name: Deep Roots
deep_roots.desc: Class passive. Your zone of control reaches 2 tiles.

bark_hide.name: Bark Hide
bark_hide.desc: Passive. +4 Defense and restore 2 Defense each turn.

barkskin_surge.name: Barkskin Surge
barkskin_surge.desc: Restore your Defense, gain +10 Defense for 2 turns and Taunt adjacent enemies.

verdant_pulse.name: Verdant Pulse
verdant_pulse.desc: Allies within 2 tiles heal and regenerate for 3 turns.

heartwood.name: Heartwood
heartwood.desc: Passive. Once per quest, survive a lethal hit with 1 HP. +10% max Defense.

world_tree.name: World Tree
world_tree.desc: Capstone. Allies within 3 tiles heal, gain +12 Defense for 2 turns and regenerate for 3 turns.

thornwall.name: Thornwall
thornwall.desc: Grow a wall of thorns for 3 turns: half cover that causes Bleed to enemies who enter it.

thorn_lash.name: Thorn Lash
thorn_lash.desc: Lash an enemy up to 2 tiles away: 1.1x damage, may cause Bleed.

thornmail.name: Thornmail
thornmail.desc: Passive. +2 Defense; enemies that hit you in melee take damage equal to 30% of your max Defense.

vine_snare.name: Vine Snare
vine_snare.desc: Vines seize an enemy up to 4 tiles away: 0.6x damage, Root for 2 turns and Pin it (-20 Accuracy).

impaling_thorns.name: Impaling Thorns
impaling_thorns.desc: Drive a spike of living wood through an enemy: 1.8x damage, may Root and Bleed.

thornstorm.name: Thornstorm
thornstorm.desc: Capstone. A storm of thorns: every enemy within 3 tiles takes 1.2x damage, Bleeds heavily and may be Rooted.

glass_edge.name: Glass Edge
glass_edge.desc: A razor cut: 1.4x damage and +20 Crit.

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.desc: Dive into the ground and resurface on any tile within 5, hitting adjacent enemies.

sandblast.name: Sandblast
sandblast.desc: A cone of scouring sand 2 tiles long. May Blind.

mirage_step.name: Mirage Step
mirage_step.desc: Blink to a tile within 3 and gain +20 Dodge for 1 turn. Uses your move, not your action.

sand_tomb.name: Sand Tomb
sand_tomb.desc: A sandstorm over a 3x3 area within 4 tiles: 0.5x damage, Blind and may Root.

sunken_strike.name: Sunken Strike
sunken_strike.desc: Capstone. Dive into the sand and burst out anywhere within 7 tiles: 1.6x damage with +20 Crit to every adjacent enemy.

shard_toss.name: Shard Toss
shard_toss.desc: Throw a glass shard up to 4 tiles: 0.9x damage, may cause Bleed.

razor_edge.name: Razor Edge
razor_edge.desc: Passive. +8 Crit; critical hits deal +25% damage.

glass_flurry.name: Glass Flurry
glass_flurry.desc: Three quick cuts of 0.45x damage, each with +10 Crit.

fracture.name: Fracture
fracture.desc: Strike through a crack in the target's armor: 1.2x damage that ignores half of Defense.

glass_heart.name: Glass Heart
glass_heart.desc: Passive. Critical hits heal you for 6 HP.

thousand_shards.name: Thousand Shards
thousand_shards.desc: Capstone. Explode in glass: every enemy within 2 tiles takes 1.3x damage with +25 Crit and may Bleed.

e_bite.name: Bite
e_bite.desc: A lunging bite from 2 tiles away. May cause Bleed.

e_terrify.name: Terrify
e_terrify.desc: A mask-face that may cause Fear.

e_charge.name: Charge
e_charge.desc: Charge a target up to 4 tiles away and knock it back.

e_tail_sting.name: Tail Sting
e_tail_sting.desc: A venomous strike from 2 tiles away.

e_grasp.name: Grasp
e_grasp.desc: Cold hands. Stronger when other Hollows are near the target.

e_hush_touch.name: Hush Touch
e_hush_touch.desc: Erases every beneficial effect on the target.

e_erase.name: Erase
e_erase.desc: Strikes one active skill from the target's memory for the rest of the fight.

e_grief_wave.name: Grief Wave
e_grief_wave.desc: A wave of silence: damage and Fear within 3 tiles.

e_rally_cry.name: Rallying Cry
e_rally_cry.desc: Allies within 3 tiles gain +10 Accuracy for 2 turns.
